transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?

Hi. Well, I made the appointment because... for a long time now, I’ve just been walking around with this flat, heavy feeling. It's like, even when work is going okay or people are nice to me, I still feel down. I just feel kind of empty most days, and I figured it was time to talk to someone about it.
Roughly how long have you been feeling this flat, empty way?
I'd say it's been going on for about two years and two months now. It started... well, right around the time this dashboard project put me in the spotlight at work.
During these past two years, have there been any periods lasting more than a couple of months where you felt back to your normal self?
No, not really. I mean, I might have a decent day here or there, but... no, definitely nothing lasting a couple of months. It's just been a pretty constant feeling this whole time.
During these past two years, were there times when this feeling became significantly more severe or intense?
Not really. It's... it's been pretty steady, honestly. I haven't noticed it getting significantly worse or anything like that. It just kind of stays at that same heavy level the whole time.
How have your energy levels been over these past two years?

They've been really low. Usually, by the time the afternoon rolls around, I’m just completely wiped out. It gets to the point where doing basic things at work, like fixing a spreadsheet error or finishing up some expense paperwork, is exhausting. Even outside of work, like trying to get myself to soccer... it honestly just feels like I’m dragging my body and my brain through mud.
How has your sleep been during these past two years?
Honestly, my sleep has been pretty normal. I don't really have any trouble falling asleep or staying asleep, and I usually get a standard amount each night. So, yeah, no real issues with that.
How has your appetite been over these past two years?
My appetite? It's been fine, really. I haven't noticed any big changes with it... I still eat about the same amount I always have. So, yeah, no issues there.
Over these past couple of years, how have you been feeling about yourself and your self-worth?

Not great, honestly. I've been feeling pretty down on myself. Like, at work, people will sometimes still bring up this dashboard I built a while ago, and... my first thought is just that I somehow fooled them. It's hard to accept the credit because I don't really believe it. And then whenever I make a small mistake, like a missed follow-up or sending an email late, it just feels like proof. Like it just proves that I’m not actually as capable as they think I am.
